about_the_game:
This is a traditional Japanese RPG game that tells the story of the protagonist "William" who has lost his memory. The game revolves around the themes of soul, memory, curse, and redemption, and players embark on adventures to gradually uncover the mysterious veil of the lost kingdom and mysterious crystal ...

The game contains a large amount of textual plot and cutscenes. The normal gameplay time for the beta version is about 2-3 hours

The gameplay is semi open world exploration, and the combat mode is turn based combat. Players can explore the map of this chapter within the current chapter, with some areas having mild decryption and a small number of side quests. Upon completion, players can receive rewards for improving their character's abilities or blueprints for crafting items. (If they get lost and don't know how to proceed to the next step, they can open their backpack to check the prompts in important items to know how to proceed.) Note: The game itself is a linear game, and after each chapter's plot ends, they will not be able to return to the map of that chapter.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains a small amount of provocative language, some cartoon violence, and specific scenes featuring characters drinking alcohol.
But there will be no sexual behavior between characters or related plot descriptions.

short_description: 这是一款传统的日系rpg游戏，在线性剧情的框架下，以回合制战斗加半开放世界探索和区域性解谜为主要玩法.. 剧情概述为失忆主人公“威廉”在狱中拯救了一名未知身份的女性AZNER从而展开的冒险...游戏以灵魂，记忆，悔过以及救赎为主题，在夺取未知结晶的旅程中结交友谊,探寻真相并逐渐揭开秘密的冒险...
